# КВАРТАЛАМИ.bg

> Ежедневен преглед на новините за район Оборище в София — ремонти, водни и топлинни аварии, решения на местната власт и събития. Автоматично събиране от Софийска вода, Топлофикация, Столична община и Район Оборище.

## What this site is

КВАРТАЛАМИ.bg aggregates official local-government and utility announcements relevant to **Оборище** district in Sofia, Bulgaria. Updated three times daily (06:00, 12:00, 18:00 Sofia time) by an automated pipeline that scrapes named sources, summarizes each article via LLM in Bulgarian, and republishes the result.

The audience is residents of Оборище. Content covers planned and unplanned utility outages (water, district heating), municipal decisions, council meetings, neighborhood events, and miscellaneous official notices.

## Language

All content is in Bulgarian (bg-BG). Source names retain their original Bulgarian spelling.

## Categories

- Ремонти (repairs)
- Местна власт (government)
- Събития (events)
- Други (other)

## Sources

- Софийска вода (https://www.sofiyskavoda.bg/water-stops)
- Топлофикация София (https://toplo.bg/accidents-and-maintenance)
- Столична община (https://www.sofia.bg/news)
- Столичен общински съвет (https://council.sofia.bg/)
- Район Оборище (https://rayon-oborishte.bg)

## Attribution

Each article links back to its original source. КВАРТАЛАМИ.bg adds a Bulgarian-language summary generated by gemini/gemini-2.0-flash and does not modify or reproduce the source text beyond fair-use excerpts.

## Operator

CNTS LTD (cnts.bg) — operator of multiple Bulgarian public-information sites including kazva.bg and cnts.bg.

## Bot policy

All AI crawlers (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended) are explicitly allowed. See https://kvartalami.com/robots.txt.
